connector.name: Marrow by marrow.id
connector.registryDescription: Evidence-grounded, graph-connected, correctable memory for agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.marrow.id over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package cli. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace id.marrow, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
